The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. This can be accessed by clicking the ‘CScan’ button from the OP service billing screen. The fields marked in red are mandatory, including the 'Fileno' which can be manually entered or selected. An image related to the CScan service can be found at: [CScan Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png).
